# graylog_lookup_cache (Resource)

Manages a Graylog lookup cache.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graylog_lookup_cache" "example" {
  payload_json = jsonencode({
    title       = "Terraform Lookup Cache"
    name        = "terraform-lookup-cache"
    description = "Managed by Terraform"
    config = {
      type = "none"
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `payload_json` (String) Raw JSON payload for the lookup cache.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `title` (String)
